page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz.

The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource distribution, this instance type offers a predictable performance profile for standard workloads. It represents a qualitatively cost-efficient option for applications requiring steady CPU performance without the overhead of specialized hardware. Suitable workloads include general-purpose web serving, application servers, microservices, and small-scale database hosting.
